productOverview.answer:
Vibes Components manufactures products across three main groups:

1. EV Battery & Charger Components: EV seals and gaskets, flame-retardant silicone rubber components for battery cell packs, dampers and cushioning pads, IP67-compliant seals and gaskets, rubber/TPU/TPE components with adhesive tapes, over-moulded metal components and busbars, and thermally conductive electrically insulative pads.

2. Wire & Connector Sealing Products: wire seals, connector seals, mat seals, dummy seals, gum seals, and peripheral seals.

3. Engineering Elastomeric Components: grommets, boots, bellows, tubes, dampers, metal-to-rubber bonded components, sealants, O-rings, washers, handlebar grips, and C-type USB charger caps.

Vibes Components also develops customized elastomeric components for customer-specific applications.

materials.answer: Vibes Components works with elastomeric materials including silicone, EPDM, NBR, polyurethane elastomers, TPU and TPE depending on the application. The company also develops custom elastomer compounds for application-specific requirements.

manufacturingProcesses.answer: Manufacturing processes listed by Vibes Components include compression moulding, transfer moulding, injection moulding and extrusion. The company also provides engineering support and custom elastomer development for application-specific components.

evComponents.answer:
Vibes Components provides engineered components for EV battery and charger applications.

Our EV solutions include:

• EV battery seals and gaskets
• Flame-retardant silicone rubber components for battery cell packs
• Dampers and cushioning pads
• Seals and gaskets for enclosure protection
• Rubber, TPU and TPE components with adhesive tape
• Metal-to-rubber over-moulded components
• Over-moulded busbar components
• Thermally conductive and electrically insulating pads
• Customized elastomeric components for application-specific requirements

For a custom EV component requirement, please share your drawing, dimensions, material requirement, operating conditions and estimated quantity.

Phone: +91 77700 12885
